content.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: heredoc title with quoted phrases

mask "no data" instead of misreading it as "instant tool" — the
{"type":"http",url,headers} snippet plus a bare open("w") call.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1
